terminal_gate.scope: Frozen HTTP/direct pipeline only; other offline agents must also be idle before current process snapshot.

cleanup.port_scope: Current network namespace, TCP IPv4/IPv6 listeners only.
cleanup.process_scan_scope: All readable argv/PGIDs and same-user executables; this is not a machine-wide absence proof for hidden foreign-user processes.
cleanup.PID_reuse_policy: Any currently present recorded numeric ID fails; no signal sent.
cleanup.monitor_scope: No monitor PID snapshot was recorded. Wrapper monitor_rc=0 proves wait completed; wrapper PGID and current exact task-path scan are also checked.
cleanup.outer_scope: The pipeline outer start/exit does not record PID/start ticks. Terminal receipt plus exact task-path scan is used; no invented PID identity.

protection.build_export_scope: Frozen archive/identity and build inputs are hashed; the exported source tree is not rescanned here.
protection.main_binary_evidence_scope: Matches this phase entry.json directly. Previous-phase runtime identity is not substituted; snapshot equality does not prove continuous absence of transient writes.

model.limit: Metadata equality is not byte-content proof or a continuous write audit.

reference.limit: No entry whole-tree manifest. Tracked-only Git observations do not cover ignored/untracked reference trees or prove no writes. This checker performs no reference writes.

cleanup_at_end.port_scope: Current network namespace, TCP IPv4/IPv6 listeners only.
cleanup_at_end.process_scan_scope: All readable argv/PGIDs and same-user executables; this is not a machine-wide absence proof for hidden foreign-user processes.
cleanup_at_end.PID_reuse_policy: Any currently present recorded numeric ID fails; no signal sent.
cleanup_at_end.monitor_scope: No monitor PID snapshot was recorded. Wrapper monitor_rc=0 proves wait completed; wrapper PGID and current exact task-path scan are also checked.
cleanup_at_end.outer_scope: The pipeline outer start/exit does not record PID/start ticks. Terminal receipt plus exact task-path scan is used; no invented PID identity.

gpu_limit: No separate GPU allocator inventory is taken; absence of owned service/process identities is checked. This is not a whole-device idle or memory-release proof.
self_hash_rule: Output does not hash itself; bind its final SHA externally.
